== Title ==
<span lang="ja">イヴラム・ラジャイ少佐</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">ヤヴィン４、ホス、またはエンドアの位置カードに彼が配備されていれば、反乱軍の宇宙船はその星系に“リアクション”として移動できる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">宇宙防衛態勢、とりわけ軌道上での戦闘を専門とする著名な<u>リーダー</u>。彼のおかげで、同盟軍はデス・スターの構造上の弱点を発見できた。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Commander Evram Lajaie.

'''Lore''' — A renowned leader who specializes in space defense, particularly combat in orbit. Thanks to him, the Alliance discovered a structural weakness in the Death Star.

'''Game text''' — If he is deployed on a Yavin 4, Hoth or Endor location card, Rebel starships may move to that system as a react.

The Japanese face says location card rather than site. Its printed rank, 少佐, is a rank equivalent to major or lieutenant commander depending on the service.<ref>[[:File:ANH-L-commanderevramlajaie.gif|Original English face]], [[Commander Evram Lajaie]].</ref>
